reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents funding an MTI account as a way to earn Bitcoin and directs viewers to send Bitcoin to a payment destination, submit transaction details, and upload proof of payment. Paid-member and trading-bonus displays, registration, and referral direction reinforce this recruitment and payment pathway. the available video evidence does not establish who controls the wallet or whether transfers or displayed results were realized.

citations.quote: How to fund MTI Mirror Trading International account & make money bitcoin
You can either scan the QR code or carefully copy the Bitcoin address to your wallet. Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin.
Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer it will appear in your trading account.

opening.argument: Judge, the narration describes a conditional account process, not a guaranteed payout: the transfer appears in the trading account only after an administrator confirms it (ASR_0001). It then promises statements reporting trade results, not a specified return (ASR_0001). The title uses the broad phrase “make money bitcoin” (TITLE_0001), but neither that phrase nor the described reporting process establishes a fixed profit or a claim that trading cannot lose money. The more precise reading is an explanation of how a member funds and monitors an account, with the financial outcome left unspecified.

citations.quote: Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer it will appear in your trading account.
Each day you will recieve a statement, via email, telling you the results of the trades.
make money bitcoin

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening correctly identifies payment instructions, but sending Bitcoin and supplying transaction details (ASR_0001) do not, by themselves, show that the destination is controlled by an impostor or that a return is guaranteed. It also acknowledges that wallet control and realized outcomes are unestablished. The conditional confirmation step (ASR_0001) is consistent with an account-funding workflow; uncertainty about the operator is not affirmative evidence that the workflow is fraudulent.

citations.quote: Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin.
Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer it will appear in your trading account.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a fixed-return promise does not resolve the concern. The title explicitly links funding the account to making Bitcoin (TITLE_0001), while the narration tells viewers to send Bitcoin and submit proof (ASR_0001). Conditional administrator confirmation concerns when an account balance appears; it does not verify the trading activity or establish that a depositor can realize the reported results.

citations.quote: How to fund MTI Mirror Trading International account & make money bitcoin
Upload the proof of payment screenshot then click submit
Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin.

opening.argument: Judge, the substance is a screen-by-screen operational walkthrough. It starts with navigation through the wallet menu (ASR_0001), explains what information the payment screen requests (ASR_0001), and shows how to inspect a daily statement (ASR_0001). Those are concrete interface instructions, not evidence that the presenter can verify profits or is promising the viewer a particular result. Even the later referral mention is framed conditionally, as something a member may choose to do (ASR_0001). Classify what the presentation actually teaches: account operation.

citations.quote: Click on the Wallet section on the left. A roll-down will appear. Click on Add funds.
Enter the blockchain transaction ID or TX ID Upload the proof of payment screenshot then click submit
Click on the view option to see your daily statement.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the walkthrough’s specificity as evidence against it, but specificity is also what makes an operational tutorial useful. The narration explains where to find account results (ASR_0001); it does not say those displayed results have been independently verified. Its optional phrasing about referring friends (ASR_0001) likewise does not establish that recruitment is required to use the account or earn anything.

citations.quote: You can also log in to your backup office to see these results and your statements .
Should you wish to refer your friends

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial can still function as a solicitation. This one is expressly about funding an account to earn Bitcoin (DESCRIPTION_0001), instructs the viewer to send Bitcoin (ASR_0001), and then introduces a registration link for friends (ASR_0001). Explaining the interface does not make that payment-and-recruitment pathway incidental.

citations.quote: How to Fund your Mirror Trading International (MTI) Account and start to make or earn bitcoin.
Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

opening.argument: Judge, the observed transaction is presented as funding a named account, with a Bitcoin amount, transaction ID, and payment screenshot supplied for reconciliation (ASR_0001). The account is then described as showing membership status and trading statements (ASR_0001). There is also an optional referral route (ASR_0001), but no cited statement says a member is paid for recruiting, must recruit to withdraw, or receives a guaranteed return. Those missing links matter: a payment workflow and a referral feature do not alone establish a deceptive investment mechanism. The record supports an account-service interpretation without certifying that the service is safe.

citations.quote: The exact amount of Bitcoin you've sent Enter the blockchain transaction ID or TX ID Upload the proof of payment screenshot then click submit
In this case your dashboard will confirm that you are a paid member.
Each day you will recieve a statement, via email, telling you the results of the trades.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening points to a payment destination and displayed account status, but its own account leaves control of the wallet and realized results unknown. The narration describes an administrator confirming a transfer into a trading account (ASR_0001), which fits account reconciliation as well as the prosecution’s inference. Nor does the optional invitation to refer friends (ASR_0001) establish a downline-income promise.

citations.quote: Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer it will appear in your trading account.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The concern does not depend on a guaranteed rate or a stated recruitment commission. The video connects account funding to earning Bitcoin (DESCRIPTION_0001), provides instructions to send Bitcoin to an address (ASR_0001), and follows with directions for referring friends (ASR_0001). A displayed membership status or emailed statement is not independent evidence that the investment activity or reported results are real.
